items.title: Hal Galper interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 27, 2022
items.q: I was in his back room with my trio, with a girl bass player from Tennessee and a drummer named John Frayas jamming in my naivete

ctx.x: You were talking about switching to a piano teacher.

Oh yeah, right. So then the last year of high school — the sophomore year of high school they thought — I was getting D’s and F’s through everything through school. But I had a talent for mechanical stuff and I was in an electrical course the second year of high school. I did great. The third year they thought I would be an engineer or a scientist so they sent me to this scientific prep school in Copley Square in Boston not realizing that The Stables was right across the street. And at lunchtime, I mean I was a…
Oh I have to make sure we spell this man’s name right, ‘cause he’s important.
